notes.title: Running on CV1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
Regarding the CV1 version, you may have to set your CV1 headset as being the default audio device on your PC before launching the game. Apologies if this is an inconvenience.

1. Right Click your audio symbol on your taskbar
2. Click "Playback devices"
3. Select the CV1 headset, and click "Set as default device"

Don't forget to make sure that you have set your Rift to be allowed to run external apps (Done from the General settings tab when the Oculus service is running).

Apologies for any inconveniences caused. I am working to get past this. 
Hope you enjoy scaring friends and family with The Visitor.
